class Weight
  attr_reader :amount, :unit

  def initialize(amount, unit)
    @amount = amount
    @unit = unit
  end

  def <=>(other)
    raise ArgumentError, "Cannot compare Weights with different units" unless unit == other.unit
    amount <=> other.amount

  def ==(other)

    raise ArgumentError, "Cannot compare Weights with different units" unless unit == other.unit
    amount > other.amount
  end

  def clamp(min, max)
